requirements.english_requirement: Test of English Proficiency (TEP) or English Short Course (ESC) required if English requirement is not met (UNITEN).
requirements.other_qualifications: Pass SPM/O-Level with minimum 5 credits (Grade C) any subjects; or UEC with minimum 3 subjects Grade B6 (including Advanced Mathematics); international applicants require a High School Certificate with minimum 50% and Grade C in Mathematics and English.
